title: Saga Rebellion
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Saga Rebellion", at revision 1376251480, opens: "The Saga Rebellion  was an 1874 uprising in Kyūshū against the new Meiji government of Japan. It was led by Etō Shinpei and Shima Yoshitake in their native domain of Hizen." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2446765, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1874 anti-Meiji uprising in Japan". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
